primaries.name: SMG
primaries.desc: Rapid fire; the spread blooms while held, and hits fade past 30 m

primaries.name: Burst
primaries.desc: Three hard, accurate rounds a pull, then a beat

primaries.name: Rifle
primaries.desc: Accurate, with mild bloom and long reach

primaries.name: Gatling
primaries.desc: Spins up while held, from a chug to a torrent, and runs hot

primaries.name: Flak
primaries.desc: A shotgun: eight pellets in a wide cone, brutal up close and fading past 15 m

primaries.name: HEAT
primaries.desc: Hold to charge a burning slug that bursts on impact; charging widens the burst from 1 to 3.5 m and speeds the slug

secondaries.name: Scatter
secondaries.desc: Nine slow flak pellets in a cone, each bursting on contact or at 60 m

secondaries.name: Hellfire
secondaries.desc: Lock-on volley: middle-click locks the enemy nearest your aim within 30° in 0.35 s, and the lock holds 2.5 s wherever you look; fire eight slow missiles that fan out wide for 0.4 s, then curve onto it, even round a corner

secondaries.name: Repair torch
secondaries.desc: Hold it on a teammate to mend 10 hp/s, or on an enemy to burn 6 hp/s, out to 28 m; runs warm while held

secondaries.name: Rocket
secondaries.desc: Straight-flying rocket with a 4 m blast

secondaries.name: Rail gun
secondaries.desc: Middle-click toggles the scope; let go of the trigger to fire one fast, flat, heavy slug

secondaries.name: Furnace
secondaries.desc: Heat-fed launcher: throws a fireball, bigger the hotter you run, venting a third of your heat, and fires even overheated

secondaries.name: Grenade launcher
secondaries.desc: Lobbed shell that bounces once or twice, then bursts wide

secondaries.name: Cluster launcher
secondaries.desc: A canister that bursts at its fuse or on a second press into six bomblets that rain down

secondaries.name: Mine layer
secondaries.desc: A sticky mine a second that bursts when an enemy comes within 3.5 m; ten down at most, and middle-click sets them all off

offensive.name: Tumbler
offensive.desc: A frag grenade, lobbed: it bounces about, then bursts

offensive.name: Limpet
offensive.desc: A remote mine: thrown, it sticks where it lands, and G again sets it off; one down at a time

offensive.name: Pall
offensive.desc: A smoke grenade: bursts into a cloud 16 m wide that hides whoever's in or behind it for 10 s

offensive.name: MG turret
offensive.desc: A tripod gun set down ahead for 20 s: it fires short bursts at the nearest enemy it sees within 40 m, until its 150 hull is shot off

offensive.name: Rocket turret
offensive.desc: A tripod launcher set down ahead for 20 s: a rocket every 2 s at the nearest enemy it sees within 60 m, until its 150 hull is shot off

support.name: Brownout
support.desc: An EMP around you: drains enemies' fuel and jams their boost

support.name: Salve
support.desc: Drops a repair orb at your feet, like a wreck's, that only your side can heal from

support.name: Shield dome
support.desc: A half-sphere 21 m across around you for 6 s: shots from outside stop at it, whoever fires them, shots from inside go out, and mechs walk through

support.name: Barrier
support.desc: Raises a wall 16 m wide and 8 m tall, 4 m ahead across your aim, for 8 s: nothing gets through, either way

abilities.name: Speed boost
abilities.desc: Refills the fuel tank, then 4 s of boost that burns no fuel and runs 25% faster

abilities.name: Vent
abilities.desc: Dump all heat at once, even when overheated

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.desc: 5 s of 40% less damage and 25% more speed on foot, but no boost

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.desc: Up to 10 s all but invisible: no tag, no radar contact, and turrets and bots can't see you. Firing or using an item drops it

abilities.name: Power shot
abilities.desc: Your next shot or volley within 6 s deals 50% more damage (a burst, all of it)

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.desc: 5 s of 25% more damage from everything you fire or throw

abilities.name: Artillery
abilities.desc: 6 s of blasts 30% wider and 10% harder, from everything you fire or throw
